# PA Legal Advice

> Kane & Silverman P.C. is a personal injury law firm serving Pennsylvania and New Jersey with specialized representation in transportation accidents, premises liability, medical malpractice, and workplace injuries.

Based in Philadelphia with additional offices in Media, PA and Marlton, NJ, Kane & Silverman P.C. provides comprehensive personal injury legal services led by attorneys Howard G. Silverman, Randall M. Justice, and Samuel G. Encarnacion. The firm offers free consultations and maintains a strong commitment to community involvement.

## Key Topics
